name: critique_comes_from_reviewer
source:
import Omar.Reactor
import Omar.Verify
open Omar.Reactor

/-- `ReviewFlow` as `omarc` compiled it: the structure the semantics speaks of,
    without prompts or code bodies. -/
def topology : Omar.Reactor.Topology where
  name := "ReviewFlow"
  instances := [
    { name := "flow", team := "ReviewFlow", parent := "" }]
  agents := [
    { name := "flow.planner", backend := "Codex", owner := "flow" },
    { name := "flow.reviewer", backend := "Codex", owner := "flow" }]
  ports := [
    { name := "flow.request", kind := .input, delay := none, owner := "flow" },
    { name := "flow.result", kind := .output, delay := none, owner := "flow" },
    { name := "flow.plan", kind := .action, delay := none, owner := "flow" },
    { name := "flow.critique", kind := .action, delay := none, owner := "flow" }]
  timers := []
  connections := []
  reactions := [
    { id := "flow.reaction.0", owner := "flow", agent := "flow.planner",
      triggers := ["flow.request"],
      contract := [{ alternatives := [{ port := "flow.plan" }], optional := false }] },
    { id := "flow.reaction.1", owner := "flow", agent := "flow.reviewer",
      triggers := ["flow.plan"],
      contract := [{ alternatives := [{ port := "flow.critique" }], optional := false }] },
    { id := "flow.reaction.2", owner := "flow", agent := "flow.planner",
      triggers := ["flow.critique"],
      contract := [{ alternatives := [{ port := "flow.result" }], optional := false }] }]

theorem critique_comes_from_reviewer (e : Execution) (hv : Valid topology e) :
    ∀ g v, e.present g "flow.critique" = some v →
      ∃ g', e.wrote g' "flow.reaction.1" "flow.critique" = some v := by
  intro g v hp
  rcases present_from hv hp with ⟨g', id, hw, -, hwr, -⟩ | ⟨c, hc, -⟩ | ⟨port, hport, hn, hk, -⟩
  · simp [topology, Topology.writers, Topology.Reaction.mayWrite] at hw
    subst hw
    exact ⟨g', hwr⟩
  · simp [topology, Topology.sources] at hc
  · simp [topology] at hport
    rcases hport with rfl | rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp_all

#omar_verify critique_comes_from_reviewer

  connections := []

    { id := "flow.reaction.0", owner := "flow", agent := "flow.planner",
      triggers := ["flow.request"],
      contract := [{ alternatives := [{ port := "flow.plan" }], optional := false }] },
    { id := "flow.reaction.1", owner := "flow", agent := "flow.reviewer",
      triggers := ["flow.plan"],
      contract := [{ alternatives := [{ port := "flow.critique" }], optional := false }] },
    { id := "flow.reaction.2", owner := "flow", agent := "flow.planner",
      triggers := ["flow.critique"],
      contract := [{ alternatives := [{ port := "flow.result" }], optional := false }] }]

theorem answer_only_after_critique (e : Execution) (hv : Valid topology e) :
    ∀ g, (e.wrote g "flow.reaction.2" "flow.result").isSome →
      (e.present g "flow.critique").isSome := by
  intro g hw
  have hc := hv.wrote_completed g _ _ hw
  obtain ⟨r, hr, hid, t, ht, htrig⟩ := invoked_from hv (hv.completed_invoked g _ hc)
  simp [topology] at hr
  rcases hr with rfl | rfl | rfl <;> simp at hid
  simp at ht
  subst ht
  rcases htrig with hp | ⟨tm, htm, -⟩
  · exact hp
  · simp [topology] at htm
